notes.title: 2025.7.18 Update
notes.notes:
The visual effect of object outlines has been enhanced

Some elemental mechanisms have been optimized, and the frequency of element calculation tick has slowed down.

Endless mode now records the highest score

Previously, the difficulty in endless mode increased with each wave of enemies, which gradually increased the damage taken by player, causing the player to be killed instantly by his own explosives. Now almost all explosive weapons have added some minor self-damage, which will not be increased by the difficulty. The difficulty increase will only increase damage from enemies. Now the difficulty will also slowly increase the health of enemies.

Added stricter air wall restrictions to prevent monsters from flying too far to unexpected locations.
Adjusted the volume of some overly noisy demon sounds and added some new random BGMs endless mode.

notes.title: 2025.7.16Update
notes.notes: [p]Bullets do a lot of calculations every time they hit, and the game is extremely intensive in hit events, so now a lot of calculations are reduced.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the scene model in the isolation chamber was not displayed. ( freaky hands )[/p][p]Some weapon modifications reduced too much damage, causing the elemental damage of card effects =0[/p][p]Many modifications no longer completely remove radiation damage.[/p][p]Now penetrating bullets will explode and disappear when the kinetic energy is exhausted, instead of flying forever, some bullets using massive penetration as unique feature like Acid Bolts not included.[/p][p]Added elemental damage icon display[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831444/a31a924cd69922235b8924621f648ea17d948df7.png"][/img][/p][p]Major changes to Ember (Twin-barrel plasma cannon) and Anvil (grenade launcher)[/p][p]Ember's default bullet splash range has become dramatically larger, making it easier to blast chunks of enemies, especially demons.[/p][p]Anvil's attack speed has been slowed down, and now the damage is more concentrated. Firing in secondary mode will launch cluster bombs, causing multiple blast damage.[/p][p]Anvil's plasma grenade mode now causes extremely high damage in a small area.[/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831444/e99783f704def28dfe2888c2af591c348db966c6.png"][/img][/p][p]A new heavy weapon has been added [/p][p]Pandemonium Cluster Grenade Launcher [/p][p]It can quickly spray a large number of explosive bullets to engulf enemies [/p][p]It cannot be picked up in the story mode at present, only in the endless siege mode. In the future, the story mode maps and effects will be reworked and a pickup method will be added. You can click a very small hidden button hidden in the upper left corner of the game's main menu to enter the developer's experimental map, which will contain upcoming things. [/p][p]Endless Siege Mode: [/p][p]Endless Siege Mode has been initially improved: [/p][p]the way to obtain weapons is now to unlock weapon boxes in the map, rather than drawing them in the card selection interface.[/p][p]The card selection interface has also been significantly improved. [/p][p][/p][p]Mediator: Damage mechanism changed: [/p][p]The angle of the barrier is now determined by the angle of the surface it hits Secondary mode is no longer a howitzer. The bullets in the secondary mode can still hit and demolish the barrier you create, but will only explode if they hit an enemy, and the enemy hit is in a radiation unstable state, which will instantly kill non-boss enemies. [/p][p]Its weapon customization plugin has been changed, and now the default shape of the barrier is a board, which is more suitable for temporary cover. [/p][p][/p][p]A lot of code optimization: It has been quite a long time since the last update, and a lot of scattered issues have been fixed during this period. [/p][p][/p][p]Fixed a critical memory leak: After the enemy dies and disappears, its projectiles still in memory. After fixing this problem, it should solve the problem of the game frame rate getting lower and lower during playtime.[/p]

notes.title: Damage System Optimization
notes.notes:
Damage mechanic changes:
Rewrote the way damage is dealt to reduce CPU usage
Enemies inside the shield are now invincible until the shield is destroyed
(This is to adapt to the new faster damage mechanic. If this makes your boss fight too difficult, please let me know)
Shields flash slower
(All to save CPU ,this will make game run better on old PC)

Mediator:
Barriers can now be attached to the enemy's body
The more times barrier explosions are chained, the higher the damage. Continuous barrier detonations will multiply the damage many times 
Optimized the explosion mechanism to reduce performance loss

Lament:
You can now aim by holding down the right mouse button, and it is the  single-shot mode
It is easier to hit distant enemies now

Shrreder:
The firing rate of the Gatling gun was 0.05/per shot  before, which was too fast for game engine or CPU to handle and caused the frame rate to affect the firing rate
Now the Gatling gun has a slightly lower firing rate, higher damage, and a larger bullet judgment volume

Weapon Description:
You will be see hint when picking up a new weapon
Press TAB to view the Readme of the current weapon in hand
Given the complex weapon mechanism of this game, this is very helpful for new players

notes.title: Enemy AI / Combat Update
notes.notes:
This is a change that increases the difficulty.
Because in the past, players could often find a safe place to stay still without being threatened.
Or slow-moving monsters could not catch up with the players, enables player to win without a fight,this is  not good.

Although this situation is unavoidable, for some melee enemies, this design mistake destroys the game mechanics, so some additional attack methods must be given to melee enemies。There can't be completely harmless demonic entity.
